hints.title: Two Recursive Levels
hints.text: The subpath can start at any binary tree node. The outer search searches for the starting node, while the inner match checks down paths.

hints.title: Match Function
hints.text: match(listNode, treeNode) checks if listNode.val == treeNode.val, then checks listNode.next on treeNode.left or treeNode.right.

hints.title: Combine Search
hints.text: return match(head, root) or isSubPath(head, root.left) or isSubPath(head, root.right).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Resetting head without checking child subtrees misses subpaths that begin further down the tree.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual recursion cleanly decouples starting node exploration from continuous path matching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate separates starting candidate exploration from downstream subpath matching.
complexity.notes: Can be optimized to O(N) using KMP prefix function on the linked list.
